content:
anya_ml: heads-up, running a FP8 enablement sweep on H100 + L40S for the new 16B model. saw a handful of intermittent NaNs on long-seq (2k+) chat traces when we enable mixed-precision kernel + awq fallback. reproducer attached to the canary but low signal so far.

sam_irvine: can you paste the minimal log snippet? which op is blowing up — matmul, gelu, or kv cache access?

anya_ml: here — logs from a failed run:```ERROR: runtime: nan in activation after block 22 (matmul_gemm), seq=2104, batch=2
stack: at runtime/engine/attn.c:245
quant profile: fp8-enabled, hybrid-gemm, kernel=fastpath_v3
fallback: attempted awq->gptq shim, then int8 fallback succeeded
```

riley_ops: interesting. what was the canary rollout %? and are these runs on dedicated or hosted? we need cluster id and model shard mapping.

anya_ml: canary 3% on dedicated h100 pool, mirrored 1% on l40s. cluster ids: red-h100-a1, red-l40s-b2. model pinned to v2026-03-16-rc.

carlos_m: two quick hunches: 1) activation scaling mismatch when switching tiling between h100/l40s; 2) kv-cache tiling + continuous batching can expose numerical drift with fp8. try forcing `--activation-scale=per-layer` and run batch_size=1 longseqs. also test with `--kv-tiling=disabled` just to sanity-check.

sam_irvine: agree with carlos. also add a short run with `--force-precision=fp16` to make sure it's not model-weight-level instability. if fp16 passes and fp8 fails, it points at quant kernel path.

deploy-bot: deploy job started: canary/enable-fp8-rc -> red-h100-a1 (3%); job id 94231.

anya_ml: ran quick experiments: per-layer scaling + kv-tiling=disabled eliminated the NaNs on H100 for 10 runs. L40S still saw 1/20 failures. fp16 run passed consistently.

riley_ops: good data. let's pause the L40S canary and open a rollback ticket for mixed-precision on that pool. @carlos_m can you own a micro-bisect across kernel variants? target: identify whether it's layout/tiling or kernel math.

carlos_m: will do. plan: 1) reproduce with deterministic seeds 2) sweep activation scaling (global/per-channel/per-layer) 3) toggle tiling and kernel versions 4) run float-emulation validation with small-batch long-seq to measure drift. timeline ~ today afternoon.

anya_ml: I also noticed quality deltas when we fall back to AWQ vs GPTQ — AWQ fallback preserved responses better but had more numerical instability under long contexts. logging prompt+response diffs to eval infra.

sam_irvine: please add a quick metric in observability: count NaN occurrences by cluster and kernel_version, and track top-3 failing trace ids. that'll help triage.

riley_ops: created rollback PR for red-l40s-b2 canary -> paused. #pr-5142

anya_ml: attaching a short repro script to run locally:```python
# repro.py
for seed in range(1000,1010):
  run_model(seed, precision='fp8', activation_scale='per-layer', kv_tiling=False)
```

carlos_m: running that now on a small h100 node. will report back with a matrix csv of (kernel,tiling,scale,pass_rate).

sam_irvine: thanks — if we confirm it's tiling, we can bake a safe rollout: enable fp8 + kv-tiling=disabled by default, and then enable tiling after kernel patch.

anya_ml: sounds good. I'll keep the canary on h100 but with per-layer scaling enforced. will update the thread with the matrix. :thumbsup:
